exposure: mode of delivery (VBAC vs. elective repeat LSCS)
cohort: 180 women with a prior cesarean section who were eligible for vaginal delivery.
finding: The study found that with proper maternal care, fetal monitoring, and institutional delivery, VBAC is considered a safe option compared to repeat elective cesarean section in selected patients.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was similar between groups (2.832 kg to 2.917kg).
